message:
Partial refunds now compute the right amount, and `npm test` passes all 20 tests.

The bug was in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`. The function documents `percent` as 0–100, but it multiplied the payment amount by it directly. A 50% refund of 1250 came out as 62500, and a 100% refund came out as 125000. I changed the calculation to `Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100)`, so the 50% case gives 625 and the 100% case gives 1250.

Nothing was committed.
